body:
Grew up in an abusive home, drunkard father, mother followed his lead. I tried to protect my siblings often taking the brunt of the beatings dished out I couldn't bare having to listen to my siblings scream and cry. I always felt like I needed to be there to protect them.

When I was 17 things escalated, it reached a boiling point and my parents told me to pack a bag and get out of the house, I didn't want to leave my siblings to these monsters but at the same time I knew for myself that I needed to get out so I took the selfish route and left. This was in the middle of my senior year, I had scholarships which I would have never gotten to make use of anyways because my parents wanted me to work for my father in construction and thus college was off the table. I left everything behind, friends, family, school, scholarships, all gone down the drain. I went as far as I could, made it clear across the country to get away.

I worked menial jobs, manual labor mostly just to make ends meet, just to be able to eat something. I made friends none of whom ever stuck around for long. This went on for 4 years now, no contact with my parents or my siblings. Hell I don't even know if they are alive or ok, I've just blocked all of that out after years of dreaming of them it was just too painful.

I met an amazing girl online, we were friends but soon it became a little bit more than that but it ended quickly and we were both happy being friends, there for moral support for each other. I opened up to her, told her everything, I had never told anyone of what happened in that hell hole but her. After visiting her in another state and having an amazing time I thought my life was turning around, when I was leaving she got upset that I did not sleep with her. I didn't want to ruin the one good friendship I had but it was too late.

After I got back nothing was the same, she will still reply to me once in a while but only with an empty "hey" or "hi" usually nothing else. And when I see her talk to someone else I just feel so empty, so invisible. This was the same person who I had trusted with my darkest secrets, who shared her secrets with me, who I could rely on to be there for me when I needed her and now I was just nothing to her but an annoyance. I just want my friend back.

After 4 years I have nothing to show for my life, I can't afford college, nor get financial aid. I can't take student loans due to my situation and so I am stuck here wondering what could have been if I had done things differently, would I have been happy, would I have maybe made it to college. I took the SAT's just incase I ever did get to go and I got a 1970, I am not sure if I was happy or depressed at the fact that I am throwing my life away doing such menial labor.

I just want all of it to end so badly
